Who may connect to `serve`: enroll, revoke, list clients (certificates from the server's own authority)

```text
dspk clients [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

**Options**

- **`--auth-dir <AUTH_DIR>`**: env `DSPK_SERVE_AUTH_DIR`  
  The server's authority folder (default: &lt;data dir>/serve, e.g. ~/.local/share/dspk/serve)

## `dspk clients enroll`

Issue a client its certificate (read only unless --control) and write it to a file to give to that client (`dspk receive --identity <file>`)

```text
dspk clients enroll [OPTIONS] <NAME>
```

**Arguments**

- **`<NAME>`**  
  Who the client is: a person or a machine (letters, digits, '.', '_', '-')

**Options**

- **`--auth-dir <AUTH_DIR>`**: env `DSPK_SERVE_AUTH_DIR`  
  The server's authority folder (default: &lt;data dir>/serve, e.g. ~/.local/share/dspk/serve)
- **`--control`**  
  Also configure, start and stop jobs, and write (not only read recordings)
- **`--out <OUT>`**  
  Where to write the client's file (default: &lt;name>.dspk-identity.pem here; `-`: to standard output, e.g. through `podman exec … > file`, so no copy stays on the server); never overwritten. Never put it under the server's data root

## `dspk clients revoke`

Refuse a client from its next connection on

```text
dspk clients revoke [OPTIONS] <NAME>
```

**Arguments**

- **`<NAME>`**

**Options**

- **`--auth-dir <AUTH_DIR>`**: env `DSPK_SERVE_AUTH_DIR`  
  The server's authority folder (default: &lt;data dir>/serve, e.g. ~/.local/share/dspk/serve)

## `dspk clients list`

The clients enrolled, active and revoked

```text
dspk clients list [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

- **`--auth-dir <AUTH_DIR>`**: env `DSPK_SERVE_AUTH_DIR`  
  The server's authority folder (default: &lt;data dir>/serve, e.g. ~/.local/share/dspk/serve)
